learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: No-history banner confirmed; trust5/5 visible ignored. Selected1.5times and locked; choices24000 and3times.
observations.exploration: Catalyst50 reduced hill75 to50kJ/mol, counter1.0 to24113crossings/s. Raise5 produced55,3205. None75 restored1.0. Reveal stayed unlocked after reset.
observations.reveal: Not quite24000times; explicitly You saw75 to50 comparison, exponential reacting share and e^-Ea/RT.298K,25kJ/mol about10RT; same pre-factor assumed, catalyst not consumed and product endpoint same.
observations.visual: Inline screenshots1257x936 dark inspected: pink reaction hill, reactants/products distinct levels, draggable peak and buttons; all reveal text legible, counter not literal simulated collision count.

prediction.reason: Linear alternatives versus dramatic rate response require clear commitment.

interaction.reason: Preset and5unit contrast visibly change hill/counter; reset confirms baseline.

payoff.reason: Relates observed rate contrast to exponential energy threshold, states fixed temperature/pre-factor condition and endpoint limit.

clarity.reason: Legible labelled hill/control/counter and historical comparison after reset. Scientific notation raises prerequisites, not UI failure.

transfer.reason: Reusable threshold principle and assumptions but no fresh concrete application.

visualExplanation.reason: Hill height depicts barrier but numeric counter and prose carry exponential explanation.

playfulness.reason: Reversible presets and5unit increments expose nonlinear rate.

practicalValue.reason: Catalyst rate effect and unchanged endpoint concretely interpreted.

depth.reason: Barrier/rate relation plus endpoint and fixed pre-factor boundaries; no variable temperature.

complexity.reason: Links barrier reduction to nonlinear reacting fraction; qualitative threshold supported by hill, full quantitative explanation uses exponential notation.
complexity.interfaceBurden: low: labelled buttons and live counter
complexity.prerequisiteNovelty: moderate: reaction barrier and energy threshold
complexity.notationRepresentationBurden: high: kJ/mol,298K,Ea,RT,e superscripts; RT not unpacked in visible reveal

whyCool: A25kJ/mol lower hill changes the counter from1 to24113, then a5unit increase collapses it to3205.
caveat: Exponential notation and RT are assumed more than explained; no new application case.
